summary: Build a React SPA for browsing crawled papers and GitHub repos, managing tags, viewing scheduled Markdown reports, and monitoring crawl status. The API is documented in docs/api-contract.md. All pages are desktop-first, single-user, no auth.

pages.description: Browse crawled papers with multi-select filters (source, category, date range, tags), full-text keyword search, and sortable/paginated results. Each row shows title, source badge, venue, published date, categories as tags, user tags as colored badges, and author names. Clicking a row navigates to PaperDetailPage. External links open paper URL and PDF URL in new tabs.

Full paper detail view: title, abstract (full text), authors with affiliations, categories, venue, published date, links to paper URL / PDF / code URL. User tags section with TagSelector to add/remove tags. If the paper has version records (merged_into_id or versions list), show a 'Versions' section linking to the other version.

Browse crawled GitHub repos with filters (language, topic, star range, recency, tags), search by name/description, and sortable columns (stars, forks, pushed_at). Each row shows full_name, description, stars/forks counts, language badge, topic tags, and user tags. Clicking navigates to RepoDetailPage. External link to GitHub.
Full repo detail: full_name, description, star/forks counts, language, topics list, last pushed date, crawl history timestamps. User tags with TagSelector.

CRUD management for user-defined tags. Table of all tags showing name, color swatch, paper_count, repo_count. Inline edit for name and color (color picker restricted to 16-color palette). Delete with confirmation dialog (warns about removal from all papers/repos). Create new tag form.
Paginated list of generated reports. Each row shows type (daily/weekly badge), date range, paper/repo counts, delivery status badge, generation timestamp. Click navigates to ReportViewPage.

Renders the report's Markdown inline using react-markdown with GFM table and code syntax highlighting support. Header shows report metadata (type, date range, counts, when generated). 'Regenerate' button calls retry endpoint.

Two sections: (1) Crawl log table with pagination -- shows source, start/end time, items found/new/updated, status badge, error message if any. Filterable by source and status. (2) Scheduler status cards showing each job's enabled state, last/next run time, last status. 'Trigger Now' button per source to manually start a crawl.

shared_components.AppShell: Sidebar + main content area layout. Sidebar has nav links: Papers, Repos, Tags, Reports, Crawls. Active link highlighted. Header shows app name 'CV Research Crawler'.
shared_components.FilterBar: Horizontal bar containing active filter chips. Each chip shows the filter dimension and value, with an X to remove. When no filters active, shows placeholder text.
shared_components.FilterChip: Small pill showing 'Source: arxiv', 'Category: cs.CV', etc. Has remove button.
shared_components.Pagination: Page numbers with prev/next. Shows 'Page 1 of 8 (150 items)'. Disabled states for first/last page.
shared_components.SortableTable: Table with clickable column headers for sorting. Shows sort direction indicator. Renders children as rows.
shared_components.TagBadge: Small colored pill. Background is the tag color at 15% opacity, text is the tag color at full opacity, with a small color dot.
shared_components.TagSelector: Dropdown multi-select for tags. Shows available tags with their color badges. Selected tags appear as removable pills above the dropdown.
shared_components.DateRangePicker: Two date inputs (from/to) side by side. Clear button.
shared_components.MarkdownViewer: Wrapper around react-markdown. Prose-styled with Tailwind typography plugin. Supports GFM tables, fenced code blocks with syntax highlighting, and heading anchors.
shared_components.StatusBadge: Colored pill: green=success/delivered, yellow=partial/running/pending, red=failed, gray=unknown.
shared_components.LoadingSkeleton: Pulsing placeholder rectangles matching the layout of the content being loaded.

types.common: PaginatedResponse<T> (items, total, page, page_size, pages), ApiError (error.code, error.message, error.details)
types.paper: PaperSummary, PaperDetail, PaperVersionRef, CategoryRef, AuthorRef, AuthorPaperRef
types.tag: TagRef (id, name, color), TagDetail (extends with paper_count, repo_count, created_at)

api_base_url: http://localhost:8000/api/v1 (development via Vite proxy; production via nginx reverse proxy)
state_management: No global state library. Each page fetches its own data via custom hooks. Tags list can be fetched once and cached in a shared hook since it's small and frequently referenced.

hooks.usePapers(params): Returns { papers, total, loading, error, refetch }. params is PaperQueryParams (page, page_size, source[], category[], date_from, date_to, q, tag_id[], sort).
hooks.useRepos(params): Returns { repos, total, loading, error, refetch }. params is RepoQueryParams (page, page_size, language[], topic[], stars_min, stars_max, pushed_after, pushed_before, tag_id[], q, sort).
hooks.useTags(): Returns { tags, loading, error, refetch, createTag, updateTag, deleteTag }. Cached globally.
hooks.useReports(params): Returns { reports, total, loading, error, refetch }.
hooks.useCrawlStatus(): Returns { logs, jobs, loading, error, triggerCrawl }.
hooks.useDebounce(value, delay): Debounces a value for search input.

excluded_from_v1: i18n framework (UI text in English, Chinese labels OK inline)
Paper recommendation or ML ranking UI
Statistics dashboard chart widgets (stats are API-ready but no visualization in V1)
